arcana-domain.summary: A cleric of the god of magic who bends Channel Divinity into their spells and borrows from the wizard's repertoire.

Arcana Domain Spells.summary: Always prepared: Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Magic Weapon and Nystul's Magic Aura at Cleric 3; Counterspell and Dispel Magic at 5; Arcane Eye and Leomund's Secret Chest at 7; Bigby's Hand and Teleportation Circle at 9.

Modify Magic.summary: As you cast a spell, spend a Channel Divinity use (no action) to alter it: one target gains 2d8 + Cleric level Temporary HP, or a creature that passes its save against the spell takes -1d6 on its next save against the spell's effect.

options.name: Fortifying Spell
options.summary: One of the spell's targets gets Temporary HP of 2d8 + your Cleric level.

options.name: Tenacious Spell
options.summary: When a creature you see passes a save against the spell, subtract 1d6 from its first save against the spell's effect.

Student of Arcana.summary: Gain Arcana (or another Cleric level 1 skill) and two Wizard cantrips; swap one of those cantrips for another Wizard cantrip each time you gain a Cleric level.

Dispelling Recovery.summary: Right after a slot-cast spell heals a creature or ends a condition on it, cast Dispel Magic without a slot as part of the same action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Once per Short or Long Rest; a Channel Divinity use restores it.

Magical Mastery.summary: Learn four Wizard spells, one per spell level from 6 to 9; they're always prepared. Each Cleric level, you may trade one for another Wizard spell of its level.
